accessibility.new: I didn't know he was staying here in your room, and that consequently on that very same day
accessibility.reason: Source: 'I did not know that he was staying here, in your room, and that consequently on the very day we quarrelled... he saw me'. What Raskolnikov did not know is that Luzhin saw him. The source's 'and that consequently' restores this more closely than the reviewer's repeated 'I didn't know that'.

In the source 29.70 is Lebeziatnikov speaking ('my room', 'all this fortnight' of expounding), and it follows Luzhin's speech with no tag. Naming the speaker is factual, adds no content, and helps listeners.
